title: The collateral-insurance claim on the target: no rule row, no deadline or claimed-amount source, no insurer interface, no re-appraisal edge and no state map
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E4-020); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD S3 Guarantees and guarantors v3.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD S3 Guarantees and guarantors v2.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD S8 Deviation handling v3.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3.md; _work/msr/context/S3.md
description: Five values the collateral-event slice needs are fixed by no source: the rule row that governs a collateral-insurance claim, since FSD S3 A2.8.3.1 states VR-S3-008-1 and BR-S3-008 only and the 32 GUA rows of the workbook hold no collateral-insurance row; the basis of claim_deadline and claimed_amount, both required fields of guarantee_claim, since no source states where a collateral-insurance claim takes them; the interface of an insurer or of SVAF for filing the claim, since TSD S3 T5.1 records INT-29 for the TCG only and as not available today and no other channel is published; the re-appraisal request path, since the feature names SVAF and FEAT-VAL-01 while Architecture v5 slide 13 gives S3 no REST edge to rwb-valuation and no operation is published; and the correspondence between the five members of LOV-CLAIM-STATUS and the X7 deviation and case states of R-DEV-06, R-DEV-09 and R-LIT-79, since the two vocabularies are never mapped.
evidence: FSD S3 A2.8.3.1 lists VR-S3-008-1 (required field empty, MSG-GEN-001) and BR-S3-008 (no value a business person may change is written in code) and no other row; A2.8.2 gives the integration points Workbench and SVAF and the prerequisite FEAT-VAL-01; A2.8.3.2 gives the seven guarantee_claim fields with claim_deadline, claimed_amount and status required. TSD S3 T3.1 lists the same eight fields, T3.2 lists LOV-CLAIM-TYPE with the member COLLATERAL_INSURANCE and LOV-CLAIM-STATUS with five members, T5.1 gives INT-29 as TCG, not available today, entered and filed by the guarantee officer, and T5.3 gives Events None. Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 gives R-DEV-06 (code in X6, X7: agent handles within policy; a person approves an insurance claim), R-DEV-09 (code in X1, X7: record the outcome) and R-LIT-79 (collateral stolen, damaged, written off or the insurance lapsed: re-appraise and return the case to the route decision at D6, SVAF and Workbench, 10 working days), and no GUA row for a collateral-insurance claim. The Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 gives FEAT-GUA-08 with systems Workbench and SVAF and the dependency FEAT-VAL-01, and FEAT-DVF-07 in S8 depends on it. The legacy story Data table names v_ace_collateral, v_ace_collateral_detail, v_ace_valuation, guarantee_claim, document, timer and decision_log_entry. The context pack gives S3 one table, two operations, zero events, zero jobs and one workflow.
proposed: Carry the two legacy criteria unchanged with their origin tags and record the target reading: the claim is a guarantee_claim row whose claim_type is the member COLLATERAL_INSURANCE of the list in force, with the deadline and the claimed amount taken at filing from the officer and the appraisal of record; the branch applies VR-S3-008-1, BR-S3-008 and the package in force and honours the person-approval condition of R-DEV-06, and takes no threshold, window or state from a GUA row; no insurer, SVAF or TCG interface is called, the officer records the filing as the business date, and the collateral and appraisal facts arrive through rwb-source-data's contract; the re-appraisal is a request on the case signal to the parent CaseWorkflow of rwb-case, which lets the route stage order the appraisal under FEAT-VAL-01, and the service adds no REST edge and no event; the five claim-row states stay the record's and the X7 and case states stay rwb-deviation's and rwb-case's, with no map invented.

title: The collateral-event branch of the guarantee-claim resource contract: no field identifier for the collateral or appraisal element, no deadline or amount basis and no text for the 409
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD S3 Guarantees and guarantors v2.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD S3 Guarantees and guarantors v3.md; 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E4-020); _work/msr/context/S3.md
description: Three values of the contract slice are fixed by no source: the field identifiers and the publication status of the collateral and appraisal elements the branch needs, since the eight fields of guarantee_claim hold none of them, the legacy Data table names them only as view columns of the ACE estate and the Logical Data Model read for this key allocates no identifier; the basis of the two required elements claimDeadline and claimedAmount for a collateral-insurance claim, which the document must declare required as TSD S3 T3.1 does while no source states what they are measured from; and the business text of the 409 of an update on a claim that is already filed, since only the status list and the message catalogue exist and no message identifier covers it. The retention rule of a claim row is likewise unstated.
evidence: TSD S3 T-A.1 gives two operations only - API-S3-001 POST /api/recovery/v1/cases/{caseId}/guarantee-claims with right C and the Idempotency-Key header, and API-S3-002 PATCH /api/recovery/v1/guarantee-claims/{claimId} with right U and idempotency not applicable - with the error statuses 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503, and T-A.2 names GuaranteeClaimRequest, GuaranteeClaimUpdate and GuaranteeClaim. TSD S3 T3.1 gives the eight fields DF-TRT-015 to DF-TRT-022 and T3.0 the seven standard columns; T3.2 gives the two list codes; T5.1 gives INT-29 as not available today; T5.3 gives no event. The legacy story Data table gives v_ace_collateral (DF-ACE-091 to DF-ACE-098), v_ace_collateral_detail (DF-ACE-196 to DF-ACE-207) and v_ace_valuation (DF-ACE-187 to DF-ACE-195) with no field identifier inside this service, and its message table holds MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P7-003 only, with no 409 text and no retention rule.
proposed: Publish the resource as TSD S3 T-A.1, T-A.2 and T3.1 state it and nothing more: the two operations on base /api/recovery/guarantee/v1, the three schemas over DF-TRT-015 to DF-TRT-022, the guarantee_claim DDL template with the T3.0 columns, the six error statuses with the problem envelope, the Idempotency-Key rule, the versioning rule and the fakes; the collateral and appraisal elements are published optional as collateralNo, collateralType, collateralValue, appraisalNo, appraisedValue and appraisalDate with no identifier and no default until the data owner allocates them; claimDeadline and claimedAmount stay required exactly as T3.1 states and no basis is fixed; the 409 is published with its cause - a claim already in FILED - and its messageId slot, and its text waits for the C1 message catalogue; no insurer, SVAF or appraisal operation and no retention rule is declared, and the retention value is carried as the placeholder of this row.
